title: RBI monetary policy: Small digital fraud victims to get up to ₹25K refund
summary: RBI MPC announced one-time compensation up to 85% of amount lost or ₹25,000 for small digital fraud victims: banks bear 15%, customer 15%, RBI/DEA fund bears 70%.
